source.ocr_note: OCR is attempted only when locally configured and necessary. If no engine is detected, scan-like documents are explicitly flagged without silently treating them as text-extracted.

counts.classification_policy: Every PDF remains a separate document node. Folder structure supplies the primary topic; repeated extracted-text matches may add cross-topic edges. Exact-file and identical-extracted-text duplicates are linked, never merged.
counts.question_content_policy: No extracted page text, question wording, or answers are stored in the graph.
